name: snapshot-tracked-source
goal: Keep exactly committed source visible to registry checks inside isolated verification snapshots.

evidence: A clean archive contains tracked iOS source, but units check omits it because the non-Git walker skips ios directories.
WorkingTreeAdapter and SnapshotAdapter lack registered method cases for archive tracked-file visibility and generated-file exclusion.
Red 48b881ef6a5d on 873a6aaad2 omitted committed iOS source and included generated source.
Commit 503d9abf60 records exported paths beside the snapshot, validates them and includes inventory drift and cleanup.
Matched red 2df714dc56de and green aee4f473e993 use the same test and environment.
